name: list-item
title: List Item
description: Presentational row with leading, secondary, trailing, density, and muted or accent variants. Option List composes this for selectable options.

api.description: Presentational row for menus, pickers, and navigation. Compose leading, secondary, and trailing slots. Option List wraps this for selection. Use asChild to merge onto a link host.

groups.title: ListItem
groups.description: Row chrome, density, and presentational state.

props.name: size
props.description: Density and type size. md matches Option List rows. sm is compact for nested nav. lg is roomier.

props.name: variant
props.description: accent uses picker hover and selected fills. muted uses quiet nav fills for catalogue and TOC rows.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected or current row appearance.

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Hover or keyboard highlight without selecting.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Non-interactive row. Sets aria-disabled.

props.name: open
props.description: Open state for submenu-style rows.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading slot. Pass an icon, "checkbox" or "check" for selection marks, or false to omit.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Supporting copy beside or under the label.

props.name: layout
props.description: inline places secondary beside the label. stacked places it underneath.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End slot for badges, chevrons, or actions.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Show a trailing check when selected.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge row props onto a single child element such as a link. The child label becomes the row label.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text, or a single host element when asChild is true.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the host.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --accent
props.description: Accent variant hover and selected fill.

props.name: --muted
props.description: Muted variant selected and hover fills.

props.name: --muted-foreground
props.description: Muted variant resting label color.

props.name: --radius-xl
props.description: Default row radius (accent).

props.name: --radius-lg
props.description: Muted row radius.

props.name: --df-text-sm
props.description: Default md type size.

props.name: --df-text-11
props.description: sm type size.
